# Slint

> Slint is a declarative GUI toolkit for building native user interfaces for applications written in Rust, C++, JavaScript, or Python. A single UI codebase targets embedded devices, desktop, and web; it compiles to native machine code and its runtime fits in under 300 KiB of RAM.

Slint is developed by SixtyFPS GmbH and is available under an open-source (GPLv3), a royalty-free, and a paid commercial license.

## Documentation

- [Slint Documentation](https://docs.slint.dev/latest/docs/slint/): Language reference and API docs for Rust, C++, JavaScript, and Python
- [Get Started](https://slint.dev/get-started): Install Slint and build your first application
- [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/slint-ui/slint): Source code, issues, and discussions
